entries.reason: Dev-server-only advisory (launch-editor: `fs.existsSync()` existence check can be bypassed on Windows). vite 5.4.x is vitest's dev dependency (devDependency of the apps), seen by pnpm audit only through the optional @sentry/cloudflare peer. No vite dev server is run in production and the Next.js build does not use vite. Fix needs vite >=6.4.4 (major bump of vitest); revisit with the toolchain upgrade.

Dev-server-only advisory (vite: `server.fs.deny` bypass on Windows alternate paths). vite 5.4.x is vitest's dev dependency (devDependency of the apps), seen by pnpm audit only through the optional @sentry/cloudflare peer. No vite dev server is run in production and the Next.js build does not use vite. Fix needs vite >=6.4.3 (major bump of vitest); revisit with the toolchain upgrade.
